steps: Resolve each listener and verify its process command belongs to this exact arm.
Terminate only the exact arm-owned SpacetimeDB and Vite listeners.
Remove the exact arm runtime directory, including both local database attempts and disposable browser profiles.
Remove the two ignored arm-local credential files.
Probe both ports, all credential paths, and the runtime path for absence.
recovery: The local database bytes and browser profiles are not recoverable after cleanup. The deterministic seed and all application source remain, so the target can be recreated.
